entries.3044764a997134eb: Its mission is to “solve the growing shortage of professional talent and make Japan a leading nation in solving challenges.” By combining the 2 technologies of IT and human resource development, it aims to provide the development and stable supply of professional talent, as well as support for business transformation that raises productivity even with small teams. In December 2025 it announced its 5-year medium-term management plan, “Medium-Term Management Plan ‘Change＆Growth2030’,” starting with the fiscal year ending October 2026, and states that it will work to build the foundation for 4 growth strategies: improving the competitiveness of its core business through strengthening human capital and organizational capabilities, promoting construction DX, expanding craftsperson placement services, and improving productivity through digital utilization and business reform.
entries.425e7f8a170ae6f4: Contraft Co., Ltd. operates "Job Ken Work," a job-change recruitment information site for craftsmen (skilled workers), and provides job seeker information, while the National Construction Human Resources Association (a general incorporated association), which holds a permit for fee-charging job placement in construction work, provides job placement for craftsmen. The revenue of this business is not disclosed separately.

entries.b232b919bf033cce: It has a system of recruiting mainly inexperienced candidates and developing them through training according to their years of experience. The age structure of its engineers is young, with approximately 66% aged 29 or under, enabling it to supply young engineers to the construction industry, which is ageing. In recruitment, it uses major job-posting media and its in-house recruitment media “Sekokan NEXT,” among others; in paid craftsperson employment placement, the group includes an organization certified as one of only 3 such organizations nationwide.
